The learner asks specifically: Make sure one of the senses is this meaning: to move to another place.

notes: ไป (pai) indicates movement away from the current speaker's location, while มา (maa) means to come toward the speaker.
It is also used as an auxiliary verb after another action verb to indicate doing something while moving or continuing an action into the future.

senses.definition: To move from one place to another, usually away from the speaker.

examples.text: ฉันอยากไปเที่ยวทะเล
examples.translation: I want to go visit the sea.
examples.emotion: excited and longing for a relaxing holiday by the water

senses.definition: To function as an auxiliary verb indicating that an action continues or is done continuously.

examples.text: เดินไปเรื่อย ๆ
examples.emotion: calm and unhurried during a peaceful stroll
